description: Ruslan Zalevskikh publishes operating measurements for oil well 807, described as a 2,400-metre-deep well drilled in 2013 in northern Russia. The provider explains daily liquid, gas, oil and water volumes in cubic metres per day, water cut in percent, dynamic level in metres and reservoir pressure in atmospheres. A single XLSX workbook is listed. The actual measurement-period endpoints are not stated and must not be inferred from the drilling year. Access has no stated charge; the Kaggle registry reserves copyright to the original authors, with no additional licence stated. A limitation is that one well and an unnamed field provide limited evidence for regional reservoir variation, while precise reuse permissions remain unspecified. Simulation uses include fitting decline or fluid-production relationships after checking the workbook. It complements data-open-power-system-data with upstream fuel-supply observations. No well measurements or reservoir model were downloaded or validated.
